maya: heads-up — putting together a small dashboard proposal to capture continuous-batcher signals we care about. want quick feedback before i file a ticket.
simon: SG. which signals are you thinking?
maya: short list: batch_util_pct, avg_queue_depth, tokens_per_sec, tokens_in_flight, kv_cache_hitrate, microbatch_latency_p50/p95, kernel_mismatch_count, fallback_rate, sample_trace_id
priya: +1. also add queue_age_histogram and batch_size_distribution. sampling at 1% might miss tail cases though.
ana: (typo) ana: agree with priya — we need tails. suggest deterministic sampling + event-driven full traces for anomalies (fallbacks, kernel switches).
maya: proposal: windows = 5s (real-time), 30s (short), 5m (trend). sampling: deterministic 1/100 requests baseline + 100% for requests that hit fallback/kernel_mismatch or kv_miss.
simon: FYI saw a perf regression Fri: profile shows kernel-selection hot path when seq_len > 1024; kernel switch + kv lookup added ~1.2ms p95 for those traces. we should alert on kernel_mismatch_count > 100/min.
maya: noted. plot idea: stacked area of batch_util by kernel_variant with overlay of avg_queue_depth; sparkline for tokens_per_sec per GPU pool.
priya: console wants token-budget target as a derived metric: tokens_allowed = reserved_tokens * (1 - cache_hitrate). can we surface that and per-route budgets?
maya: yes — will include derived metric and per-route breakdown. also anomaly rule: token/sec drop >30% while queue_depth rises -> possible starvation/throttle.
nana: ana: can we tag kv_hitrate by prefix/model_family? that'll help correlate cold prefixes and tail kernels.
simon: sample PromQL for batch_util: sum(rate(batch_tokens_total{pool=~".*"}[30s])) / sum(rate(pool_capacity_tokens_total{pool=~".*"}[30s])) * 100
maya: nice. i'll mock a grafana layout: top row: batch_util (by kernel), avg_queue_depth, tokens_per_sec; mid row: batch_size_hist, microbatch_latency p50/p95; bottom: kv_cache_hitrate heatmap + recent traces.
priya: add a small table for recent kernel_mismatch examples (trace id, seq_len, model_family, kv_hitrate) so SRE can triage.
simon: also add a counter for fallback_rate and an alert when fallback_rate > 0.5% sustained 5m.
maya: OK. i'll assemble draft and attach screenshot in thread. filing ticket TKT-5423 to track. assigning @priya and @ana to own rollout.
deploy-bot: dashboard draft -> staging deploy scheduled: 2024-07-12T16:00Z :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all — will post the draft link shortly and paste the ticket.
